payload.title: Kanbus API: support parent links in writes
payload.description: Cross-repo dependency (AnthusAI/Kanbus, services/kanbus-api). The writable API rejects creating or changing parent links and deleting hierarchical issues (unsupported_relation_mutation). Babulus's campaign tree needs either this or a flat design with custom.* references. Decide with the Kanbus session; if building it, file it on the Kanbus board.
